table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	AliasName = T.AliasName,
	Supplier = T.Supplier,
	Manufacturer = T.Manufacturer,
	Sales = SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN T.Value ELSE 0.00 END),
	SR = SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'SR' THEN T.Value ELSE 0.00 END),
	NetSale = SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN T.Value WHEN 'SR' THEN - (T.Value) ELSE 0.00 END),
	SalesTax = SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN T.SalesTax WHEN 'SR' THEN - (T.SalesTax) ELSE 0.00 END),
	Pur = SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'P' THEN T.Value ELSE 0.00 END),
	PR = SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'PR' THEN T.Value ELSE 0.00 END),
	NetPur = SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'P' THEN T.Value WHEN 'PR' THEN - (T.Value) ELSE 0.00 END),
	PurTax = SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'P' THEN T.SalesTax WHEN 'PR' THEN - (T.SalesTax) ELSE 0.00 END),
	NetTax = SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN T.SalesTax WHEN 'SR' THEN - (T.SalesTax) ELSE 0.00 END) - SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'P' THEN T.SalesTax WHEN 'PR' THEN - (T.SalesTax) ELSE 0.00 END),
	GP = SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN T.Value WHEN 'SR' THEN - (T.Value) ELSE 0.00 END) - SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'P' THEN T.Value WHEN 'PR' THEN - (T.Value) ELSE 0.00 END),
	GPRate = ((SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN T.Value WHEN 'SR' THEN - (T.Value) ELSE 0.00 END) - SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'P' THEN T.Value WHEN 'PR' THEN - (T.Value) ELSE 0.00 END)) / CASE WHEN SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN T.Value WHEN 'SR' THEN - (T.Value) ELSE 0.00 END) <> 0 THEN SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN T.Value WHEN 'SR' THEN - (T.Value) ELSE 0.00 END) ELSE 1 END) * 100
FROM 
	(SELECT
		Type = 'P',
		AccCode=A.AccCode,
		AliasName=A.AliasName,
		Supplier=A.Name,
		ManfCode=M.ManfCode,
		Manufacturer=M.Name,
		Value = SUM((PD.PackQty + PD.LooseQty + PD.BonusQty) * PD.PurPrice * (1 - PD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - P.DiscPerc * 0.01)),
		SalesTax = SUM((PD.PackQty + PD.LooseQty + PD.BonusQty) * PD.PurPrice * (1 - PD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * PD.GSTPerc * 0.01) + 
				SUM((PD.PackQty + PD.LooseQty + PD.BonusQty) * PD.UnitSalesTax)
	FROM
		Manufacturer M,
		Supplier S,
		Accounts A,
		PurLedger P,
		PurDetail PD,
		Item I
	WHERE
		P.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		P.SuppCode=S.SuppCode AND
		S.SuppCode=A.AccCode AND
		S.SuppCode IN (:ai_suppcode) AND
		P.PurInvCode=PD.PurInvCode AND
		PD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode
	GROUP BY
		A.AccCode,
		A.AliasName,
		A.Name,
		M.ManfCode,
		M.Name
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		Type = 'PR',
		AccCode=A.AccCode,
		AliasName=A.AliasName,
		Supplier=A.Name,
		ManfCode=M.ManfCode,
		Manufacturer=M.Name,
		Value = SUM((PD.LooseQty + PD.BonusQty) * PD.PrPrice * (1 - PD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - P.DiscPerc * 0.01)),
		SalesTax = SUM((PD.LooseQty + PD.BonusQty) * PD.PrPrice * (1 - PD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * PD.GSTPerc * 0.01) + 
				SUM((PD.LooseQty + PD.BonusQty) * PD.UnitSalesTax)
	FROM
		Manufacturer M,
		Supplier S,
		Accounts A,
		PrLedger P,
		PrDetail PD,
		Item I
	WHERE
		P.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		P.SuppCode=S.SuppCode AND
		S.SuppCode=A.AccCode AND
		S.SuppCode IN (:ai_suppcode) AND
		P.PrInvCode=PD.PrInvCode AND
		PD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode
	GROUP BY
		A.AccCode,
		A.AliasName,
		A.Name,
		M.ManfCode,
		M.Name
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		Type = 'S',
		AccCode=A.AccCode,
		AliasName=A.AliasName,
		Supplier=A.Name,
		ManfCode=M.ManfCode,
		Manufacturer=M.Name,
		Value = SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)),
		SalesTax = SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01) + 
				SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.UnitSalesTax)
	FROM
		Manufacturer M,
		SupplierManufacturers SM,
		Supplier S,
		Accounts A,
		SaleLedger SL,
		SaleDetail SD,
		Item I
	WHERE
		SL.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		SL.SaleInvCode=SD.SaleInvCode AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode AND
		M.ManfCode = SM.ManfCode AND
		SM.SuppCode = S.SuppCode AND
		S.SuppCode = A.AccCode AND
		S.SuppCode IN (:ai_suppcode)
	GROUP BY
		A.AccCode,
		A.AliasName,
		A.Name,
		M.ManfCode,
		M.Name
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		Type = 'SR',
		AccCode=A.AccCode,
		AliasName=A.AliasName,
		Supplier=A.Name,
		ManfCode=M.ManfCode,
		Manufacturer=M.Name,
		Value = SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)),
		SalesTax = SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01) + 
				SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.UnitSalesTax)
	FROM
		Manufacturer M,
		SupplierManufacturers SM,
		Supplier S,
		Accounts A,
		SRLedger SL,
		SRDetail SD,
		Item I
	WHERE
		SL.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		SL.SRInvCode=SD.SRInvCode AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode AND
		M.ManfCode = SM.ManfCode AND
		SM.SuppCode = S.SuppCode AND
		S.SuppCode = A.AccCode AND
		S.SuppCode IN (:ai_suppcode)
	GROUP BY
		A.AccCode,
		A.AliasName,
		A.Name,
		M.ManfCode,
		M.Name) T
GROUP BY
	T.AliasName,
	T.Supplier,
	T.Manufacturer
